visual_base.visual_narrative_log: (1) The video begins with a high-resolution photo montage showcasing a muscular male character in various outfits. Initially, he stands before a blue and red graffiti wall wearing a black mesh button-down and black shorts. The lighting is natural and bright. The montage then shifts to him inside a clothing store wearing a green quarter-zip pullover and grey trousers, followed by a shot outside a storefront labeled 'TEAMJOINED'. (2) The scene transitions into live video as the man, wearing a black t-shirt and grey athletic pants, walks along a wet urban pavement towards the glass entrance of a store. He performs a brief, fluid turn to look back at the camera with a confident smirk. The camera follows him in a medium-full tracking shot, capturing the modern architectural exterior and metal railings of the urban setting. (3) The man enters the store, which is brightly lit with professional studio-style lighting. He is seen running through the doorway in a black open shirt over a white base. The interior features neatly arranged racks of multicolored athletic garments. The character's movements are energetic and agile, emphasizing a fit and active persona. (4) Inside the retail space, a series of quick cuts show the character changing into a black sleeveless training top and grey shorts. He engages in playful, rhythmic movements and light dancing while smiling broadly at the lens. The background remains consistent with the retail store's high-end, organized interior, showing various fitness apparel on hangers and shelves.

audio_base.audio_narrative_log: (1) From 0:00 to 0:11, the audio track is entirely silent. There are no ambient environmental sounds, background music, or human voices present. This silence creates a focused void that emphasizes the visual slideshow of photos. (2) At 0:11, a high-energy hip-hop track begins abruptly. The music features a sharp, percussive electronic beat with a consistent kick and snare pattern. A male singer's voice enters immediately, delivering rhythmic English vocals with high emotional arousal and a mid-range pitch. The audio is studio-clean with no audible background noise or incidental sound design, resulting in a pristine signal-to-noise ratio. The music maintains a steady tempo and intensity until the end of the video.
